items_flat.title_en: Musk says he still prefers the Grok app to Grok Bot on hard tasks
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱部分難題仍更愛用 Grok App 而非 Grok Bot
items_flat.summary_en: On 30 Aug UTC, Elon Musk posted that he personally still finds the Grok app more useful than Grok Bot for some tasks and urged users to retry it on difficult work, linking the iOS Grok app. Separately he shared a grok.com clip showing a specific video he said he edited and enhanced, with a follow-up “Coming soon.” xAI’s official account did not post a matching product changelog in the window.
items_flat.summary_zh: 8月30日（UTC）馬斯克發文稱，部分任務他個人仍覺得 Grok App 比 Grok Bot 好用，並請用戶用難題再試一次，同時附上 iOS Grok App 連結。另分享 grok.com 短片，稱能針對特定片段編輯與增強，並寫「Coming soon」。同窗內 xAI 官方帳號未發對應產品更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is executive product positioning, not a named model or API ship. It signals that xAI is still treating the consumer Grok app and the Bot/teammate surface as distinct, but “Coming soon” remains unspecified until an official changelog appears.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長層級的產品定位，不是具名模型或 API 發布。它顯示 xAI 仍把消費端 Grok App 與 Bot／隊友介面分開推，但「即將推出」在官方更新出現前內容不明。
items_flat.quote: Should say that I personally still find the @Grok app more useful for some tasks than @Bot. Worth trying it out on super tough tasks if you haven’t in a while.
items_flat.quote_zh: 應該說，有些任務我個人仍覺得 @Grok App 比 @Bot 好用。若一陣子沒試，值得拿超難題再跑一次。

brief_en: Quiet 12-hour window into 31 Aug Taipei time: no official model, API, pricing, or paper ships from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, or xAI. Only notable lab-adjacent signal was Elon Musk on X comparing the Grok app to Grok Bot and sharing a Grok video-edit clip. No new model releases.
brief_zh: 台北時間 8/31 過去12小時無大廠正式出貨：OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta、xAI 皆無新模型、API、定價或論文。唯一可核實訊號是馬斯克在 X 比較 Grok App 與 Grok Bot，並示範影片剪輯。無新模型發布。
